sources: Chivers, Seto, Lalumière, Laan & Grimbos (2010), Agreement of self-reported and genital measures of sexual arousal in men and women: a meta-analysis, Archives of Sexual Behavior 39(1), 5–56 – 132 laboratory studies (1969–2007), 2,505 women and 1,918 men; agreement between self-reported and genital arousal r = .66 for men and r = .26 for women; part of the difference is explained by method (stimulus variety, timing of the self-report).
